exercises.question: Which sentence has a relative clause with a preposition?
options: El fallo afecta a un servicio del que dependen muchas personas. [The fault affects a service on which many people depend.]
El fallo afecta a un servicio que funciona muy bien en la ciudad. [The fault affects a service that works very well in the city.]
El fallo afecta a muchas personas que viven en esta ciudad. [The fault affects many people who live in this city.]

exercises.sentence: Se ha producido una __ que afecta a todo el edificio.
exercises.english: A breakdown has occurred that affects the whole building.
There is a traffic jam that prevents buses from arriving on time.

sentences: Primero, se ha producido una avería. [First, a breakdown has occurred.]
Después, la avería afecta a un servicio del que dependen muchas personas. [Then the breakdown affects a service on which many people depend.]
Finalmente, tenemos un obstáculo que dificulta la solución. [Finally, we have an obstacle that makes the solution difficult.]

exercises.question: Which word means something that stops progress?
options: obstáculo [obstacle]
avería [breakdown]
fallo [fault]

exercises.sentence: El fallo afecta a un servicio del que dependen muchas personas.
options: The fault affects a service on which many people depend.

exercises.sentence: Hay un atasco que impide que los autobuses lleguen a tiempo.
options: There is a traffic jam that prevents buses from arriving on time.
There is no traffic on the road so buses can travel without delays.

exercises.sentence: Esta es la avería de la que hablamos ayer.
exercises.english: This is the breakdown we talked about yesterday.

options: Se ha producido una avería que afecta a todo el edificio. [A breakdown has occurred that affects the whole building.]
Se ha producido una avería que afecte a todo el edificio. [A breakdown has occurred that affect (subjunctive) the whole building.]
Se ha producir una avería que afecta a todo el edificio. [A breakdown has produce that affects the whole building.]
Se ha producido en el edificio en el que vivimos. [It happened in the building we live in.]
Se ha producido en el edificio que vivimos. [It happened in the building that we live.]

template.prompt: Say there is a breakdown that affects a service on which many neighbours depend.
template.answer: Hay una avería que afecta a un servicio del que dependen muchos vecinos.

template.prompt: Say that the traffic jam is an obstacle that makes the solution difficult, because the buses arrive late.
template.answer: El atasco es un obstáculo que dificulta la solución porque los autobuses llegan tarde.
